biggest_catch: You only get paid if your referral actually signs a Sunrun agreement, gets Sunrun sign-off within a year, and proceeds toward installation — a friend merely requesting a quote earns you nothing. The $1,000 is typically paid as a prepaid/gift reward card (not cash, non-transferable, expires 6 months after issuance).
catches: Payment is contingent on a completed conversion: the referee must sign a Sunrun Customer Agreement, receive Sunrun Sign Off within one year of the referral, and pay any upfront/deposit fees — referrals that don't convert earn $0.

The $1,000 Referral Reward is issued in a form determined by Sunrun — typically a prepaid or gift reward card (Visa) that is non-transferable, not for resale, not redeemable for cash, and expires six months after issuance.
Both your and the referee's Sunrun accounts must be paid in full and in good standing at the time of payment.
Reward arrives within 90 days of installation beginning on the referee's system (per the general terms) — this is a months-long wait, not instant.
Cannot refer someone in the same household (second-home exception only); first to submit wins if multiple people refer the same person.
Rewards may be taxable — Sunrun may require tax documentation to issue a 1099; participants are responsible for reporting the reward.
Sunrun reserves the right to suspend or cancel promotions without notice.
